Based on the published Apache-2.0 libxgwx 0.1.0 source. The native extension adds scoped preview/generation of I/O variables in src/io_variables.rs, src/writer.rs and src/document_api.rs. Filtering occurs after full-project planning so physical addresses and native validation do not change. Empty IEC local-symbol tables also support their first insertion without requiring a synthetic whitespace node; unknown child layouts remain guarded. The same extension is present in the library checkout for upstream release. This package-relative dependency override keeps the MCP build portable.
